name: Boucherie West Village
description: Boucherie West Village is a traditional French brasserie and steakhouse celebrating Joie de Vivre in the heart of West Village. The restaurant features an ample menu of French classics and timeless bistro favorites, such as the Mousse de Foie Gras and our signature Boucherie Burger, in addition to delectable dry-aged meats. Alongside an extensive wine list featuring our exclusive Boucherie Wine Collection, guests can enjoy signature cocktails, absinthe drinks, non-alcoholic options, craft beers, and more. Located in the building that once housed the prominent Circle Repertory Theater, our 320-seat restaurant offers a diverse array of dining experiences. These include the spacious dining room, butcher counter seats, and the intimate second-floor gallery with private dining and an outdoor café, all exuding timeless charm and Parisian elegance. We look forward to welcoming you! *Please note that kitchen hours may differ.

name: Club A Steakhouse
description: Established in 2008. Bruno Selimaj was born and raised in a small village on the Northern Albanian/Montenegrin border and began his life as simple farmer. But at the tender age of 18 and with his parents blessing, he embarked on a journey to America in search of new life. In an Albanian household, it is tradition that a guest is treated with the utmost respect and as a member of the family. Bruno brought these core family values to his restaurant and Bruno Selimaj's life defines true restaurant hospitality. In December 2007, Bruno closed his legendary restaurant after 30 years with a new idea and a continuing passion to strive to be the best. He re-opened his famed restaurant as Club A, a modern American steakhouse in the same location. His new venture manages to encompass the characteristics of a traditional steakhouse and new world modernism. His latest accomplishment has established Bruno as one of New York's legendary restaurateurs.

description: With a dazzling dining gallery featuring 40’ glass ceilings, this brasserie and steakhouse is built in the tradition of the Belle Époque, inspired by elegant Art Nouveau design. The menu highlights timeless French classics, from hors d’œuvres and plats principaux to desserts crafted to embody true joie de vivre, alongside a diverse selection of prime steaks, an in-house dry-aged meat program, and premium A5 Japanese wagyu. Guests may dine with us throughout the day, with offerings spanning breakfast, brunch, lunch, late lunch, dinner, a lunch prix fixe, and our pre-theatre menu. Our beverage program presents an elevated selection of signature and mini cocktails, non-alcoholic creations, barrel-aged spirits, absinthe, and beer, complemented by an extensive wine list. We also feature the Green Hour menu, offering a curated selection of cocktails and an assortment of exquisite bites. We look forward to welcoming you! *Please note kitchen hours may differ.
